prompt:
Precise LOCAL EDIT of ONLY the three floating talisman faces in IMAGE 1. Keep the entire character, head/body proportions, face, pose, hair, antennas, hands, outfit, cloak silhouette, cloak motifs, long tails, colors, rendering and background exactly as they are. Preserve the three existing rectangular ivory paper slips, their current placement, size, angle and dark-purple paper borders.

REPLACE ALL THREE OLD REPEATED VIOLET CALLIGRAPHIC SYMBOLS with THREE DISTINCT SIMPLIFIED ELEMENTAL ICONS. Left to right:
LEFT PAPER = LIGHTNING talisman. ONE thick compact angular Z-shaped golden-yellow lightning bolt with a deep-purple/brown shadow face. Use IMAGE 2's project lightning gem as the shape and rendering reference, greatly simplified to 2–3 main value planes.
CENTER HIGH PAPER = FIRE talisman. ONE orange-red flame silhouette with one tall curling middle tongue and two short side tongues, a broad warm yellow inner face and deep red shadow. Use IMAGE 3's fire gem reference, simplified to 2–3 coherent color groups.
RIGHT PAPER = ICE talisman. ONE pale-cyan/ice-blue stout SIX-BRANCHED snow-crystal silhouette with a simple central hexagon and thick short arms, dark-blue outline and 2–3 large light/shadow planes. Use IMAGE 4's project frost gem reference, simplified for tiny-size legibility.

The icons must remain INSIDE the paper faces, each centered and occupying about 60–70 percent of the usable paper face. Adapt each graphic to its paper's tilt and perspective. No icon floats outside its paper or covers the hand/character. Paper ground remains warm ivory, not full colored cards. Make each icon identifiable immediately by BOTH DIFFERENT SILHOUETTE and DIFFERENT COLOR. Do not use the same symbol recolored.
Remove the old top crowns, long vertical strokes, branches and doodles completely; do not overlay elemental icons on top of them. Keep only ONE tiny simple red square seal near the bottom of each paper as a quiet Daoist talisman cue. No extra calligraphy, letters, words, numbers or fine border ornament.
Rendering MUST be the project's matte hand-painted GEM ICON aesthetic: strong dark organic outline, broad clear colored planes, restrained broad highlights and sparse brushwork; no photoreal crystals, neon glow, effects, shards, icon badges or complex facets. Use the references only for these three tiny elemental emblems, never apply their object shapes/colors to the character.
The output is the same complete square character artwork with only the three talisman designs locally replaced. Preserve the four-head compact youthful character and all modest clothing. No new pose, crop, layout, comparison panel or extra objects.
purpose: Local talisman replacement: lightning/fire/ice, left to right, simplified using the project's elemental gem icon references.
visual_review: Three distinct talisman emblems visible: golden lightning left, orange-red flame center, cyan ice crystal right; ivory papers and small red seals retained.
